name: PostgreSQL
description: Relational database used by authentik, Immich (with vector extensions) and Dispatcharr's modular mode. Each app runs its own PostgreSQL inside its project.
maintainer: PostgreSQL Global Development Group (Docker official image)
installNote: Installed as part of the app that needs it (authentik: postgres:16-alpine; Immich: its own image with vector extensions; Dispatcharr modular: postgres:17), on that app's private network and never published. A shared database for several apps is not offered, so one app's upgrade or failure cannot affect another.
